newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota mayor says wire pan scourers very dangerous.
newsitem.headline: Bogota mayor says wire pan scourers very dangerous.

text.p: Youngsters in Bogota have been using wire-wool pan scourers as makeshift fireworks causing Mayor Antanas Mockus on Saturday to call for strict controls on their sales.

In the days before Christmas, children have found a way around the capital's year-old ban on fireworks by waving around the flammable, wire pan cleaners like sparklers or swirling them on a piece of string like pinwheels.

"These pan scourers are as dangerous as the most dangerous fireworks. Children should not play with these things like this. I will...see if we can find a way to control the sale of these scourers," Mockus told the NTC TV news programme.
Mockus had banned the sale and use of all fireworks in Bogota in a bid to cut a rising number of burns and accidents.
